source: Constructed Scryfall-compatible fixtures for fixed combat-entry keyword lifecycle tests

cards.name: Generic Ninjutsu Adept
cards.oracle_text: Ninjutsu {1}{U} ({1}{U}, Reveal this card from your hand, Return an unblocked attacking creature you control to its owner's hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.)

cards.name: Generic Commander Ninjutsu Adept
cards.oracle_text: Commander ninjutsu {U}{B} ({U}{B}, Reveal this card from your hand or the command zone, Return an unblocked attacking creature you control to its owner's hand: Put this card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.)

cards.name: Generic Sneak Adept
cards.oracle_text: Sneak {1}{B} (You may cast this spell for {1}{B} if you also return an unblocked attacker you control to hand during the declare blockers step. It enters tapped and attacking.)

cards.name: Generic Web-Slinging Adept
cards.oracle_text: Web-slinging {1}{G} (You may cast this spell for {1}{G} if you also return a tapped creature you control to its owner's hand.)

cards.name: Generic Encore Adept
cards.oracle_text: Encore {2}{B} ({2}{B}, Exile this card from your graveyard: For each opponent, create a token that's a copy of this card that attacks that opponent this turn if able. The tokens gain haste. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step. Activate only as a sorcery.)

cards.name: Generic Blitz Adept
cards.oracle_text: Blitz {1}{R} (You may cast this spell for its blitz cost. If you do, it gains haste and 'When this creature dies, draw a card.' Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.)

cards.name: Generic Myriad Adept
cards.oracle_text: Myriad (Whenever this creature attacks, for each opponent other than defending player, you may create a token that's a copy of this creature that's tapped and attacking that player or a planeswalker they control. If one or more tokens are created this way, exile the tokens at end of combat.)
